self_hash_policy: The manifest does not hash itself. Bind the manifest SHA-256 in any later Gate 0 acceptance or freeze receipt.
claim_boundary: A manifest or verifier PASS proves only artifact identity and implemented checks. It is not canon acceptance, peer review, mathematical verification, empirical validation, product licensing, or disclosure approval.
